items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five ACs implemented: guard hook, no-block exits, blocker CLI, bounded counters, SKILL rule + reference + hooks doc.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Hook is fail-open on any exception (stderr diagnostic); git calls have 5s timeouts; state and transcript reads tolerate OSError/ValueError.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: run_id and pending keys sanitized before entering the block reason; blocker CLI uses a closed code list and validates the run id; no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 18 tests incl. real subprocess hook runs from main checkout and worktree, boundary counters, real transcript shape.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Incremental transcript scan by stored offset; no network calls at Stop time.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: lib 215 lines, hook 80, CLI 46; shared/lib + thin plugin hook mirrors iterate_stop_finalize.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer pairs listed in the spec; round trip covered by hook subprocess tests (stdin JSON, pointer file, state file, blocker CLI -> hook).
